shots.purpose: Launch the scene as Fuzzby’s self-appointed parade already in motion: funny because his importance is faster than his steering.
shots.performanceAssignment: Fuzzby’s chest and chin lead like he is announcing a parade before his eyes have chosen a route. His wings commit too hard, so every dodge becomes an overcorrection: a shoulder clips one stem, the stem whips back into nearby petals, pollen clings to him, and his attempt to shake it off only throws him into the next near-miss. He refuses to acknowledge any of it until the final pop-back, where he arrests himself in a strained official hover, the body still dusted in evidence. Lip-sync the approved @Audio1 performance exactly; no additional speech.
shots.camera: The camera follows and struggles to keep up with Fuzzby, briefly losing him behind stems and pollen bursts; Zenny remains readable in depth as the calm measure he keeps orbiting past.
shots.openingPose: Bee-height between towering flower stems, Fuzzby already slanting hard across the frame with pollen streaming from his path; Zenny is deeper among the flowers, level and undisturbed over her own work.
shots.cutInMotivation: Cutting to Zenny’s steadier frame is stronger than staying in the chase because remaining continuous would trap us inside Fuzzby’s self-image; the comedy needs his chaos measured against competence, not merely extended.
shots.dialogueBinding: Fuzzby's vocal beat performs per the approved voice design.

shots.continuityProseOut: Fuzzby ends visibly dusted by pollen in a strained hover, with loose pollen still drifting in the flower corridor; Zenny remains steady deeper among the flowers, unchanged by his chaos.
shots.dialogueTimingProse: Fuzzby’s chant begins after the first committed wingbeat, not on frame one, and stays glued to the dodge-hit-recover rhythm so the ending smears into the mishap. “Nailed it.” lands only after the pop-back and miniature held pose, followed by a short beat where pollen drift or body wobble answers him.
shots.referenceRolesProse: Fuzzby and Zenny character references anchor identity and scale; the shared flower-stem/pollen rainforest scene look anchors material, lighting, depth, and environment; approved @Audio1 anchors exact lip-sync and vocal timing.
shots.principalPerformanceApproved: Fuzzby drives the chant as exertion and self-hype — “BIZZY-BIZZY-BIZZY, BIZZY-BIZZY-BIZZY…” — then covers an obvious mishap with “Nailed it.” as if saying it can restore authority. Zenny stays absorbed in her precise gathering, not yet granting him the stage.
shots.animationTimingApproved: Keep the chant on quick, effortful wingbeats: short accelerations, tiny panic-corrections, and no graceful glide. Contacts read in crisp cause-and-effect bursts — hit, spring-back, pollen bloom — with Fuzzby always recovering a fraction late. On “Nailed it.” give him a miniature held pose, just long enough for pride to appear, then let one last pollen drift or body wobble betray the cover-up.
